recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast monochrome composition featuring a central line of serif typography that has been digitally manipulated with a horizontal 'slice and shift' glitch effect, set against a vast white void.
coreVisualRelationships: Distorted text centered in a high-ratio negative space
Black ink-like forms against a pure white background
Geometric horizontal displacement versus organic serif curves
Small-scale metadata anchored in the bottom right corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary text is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 40% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central horizontal 'slice' that runs through the middle of the lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the distorted central text, follows the horizontal glitch line, then drops to the bottom right corner metadata.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extremely high; white space acts as a vacuum to emphasize the typographic distortion.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Absolute binary contrast with no mid-tones or gradients.

letterConstructionRules: Horizontal slicing at the x-height line
Lateral displacement of the middle section
characterSpecificRedesigns: The middle third of each character is shifted left or right
The 'S' and 'C' curves are broken by the horizontal shift
The 'I' stem is segmented into three distinct blocks

treatment.fill: Black on white / White on black

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for expression paired with a utilitarian sans-serif for technical data.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high-contrast vertical strokes for the glitch to look sharp.
A more traditional serif that creates a 'corrupted classic' feel when glitched.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A solid, flat white canvas with no texture or shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the main text in a bold high-contrast serif. Apply a horizontal rectangular selection through the center of the text and nudge it 10-15 pixels to the left or right. Add a small rectangular advisory-style block in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the text distortion strictly horizontal?
Is the typography a high-contrast serif?

mustRedesign: Specific wording of the central text
Exact logo or advisory branding in the corner

mustAchieve: Sharp, aliased edges on the glitch

postGenerationChecks: Check for any unintended color artifacts
Ensure the glitch doesn't make the text unreadable
Verify the bottom right element is properly aligned to margins
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast serif + horizontal slice displacement + white void background = Brutalist Minimalist Typography.
